collect-token-metrics.name: Collect Token Metrics
collect-token-metrics.description: Incrementally scan OpenClaw session transcripts and write immutable hourly token-usage buckets.

session-refresh.name: Session Refresh
session-refresh.description: Refresh idle or oversized OpenClaw sessions to manage context window costs.

refresh-token-rates.name: Refresh Token Rates
refresh-token-rates.description: Seed the token rate card if missing, then refresh per-model $/MTok rates from the OpenRouter model API (no LLM). Fails if the rate card is missing or invalid, or any provider model can't be resolved.
